It will also be the last content build for the demo which will going into maintenance mode where the demo will only receive patches. events.title: Crownfront is Releasing Earlier
events.summary: Hi everyone! I've decided that Crownfront will be launching much earlier as progress comes along much faster. Some features that were originally planned for EA won't be in the main game but the rest will be. The game also won't be launching into EA and instead will make a full release.Crownfront's new release date is November 13, 2026.Kind Regards,KolaCape
